name: Seiryuu no Gou
source:
Earth Age: 22 years old.
Special Trait: Heterochromia
Element: Fire
Abilities: Can control natural disasters/Owns the Seiryuu Sword/Attack Type

A brave angel with a strong will and pure heart.
He has a short tempered side, but usually he's good at looking after people, he's the reliable big brother type.
He has a surprisingly playful side too.
